[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (Histogram -2.1568→0.4525): Showing improvement after bottoming, potential for bullish reversal.

· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Indicating recovery signal, potential for trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Five consecutive daily closes in the green, but confirmation of resistance breakout is needed; meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
